value.a:
When an attack with [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] results in a critical wound, the attack sequence ends for that attack. Those wounds will not be in the ‘pool’ of wounds that your opponent resolves when you use this stratagem, and the mortal wounds that result from those attacks will still be suffered by the target unit (your POXWALKERS unit cannot ‘absorb’ them).

Example: If your opponent’s two [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks result in one wound and one critical wound, your opponent would resolve the wound as described in your stratagem, but the attack sequence would end for the critical wound, and your opponent’s target would suffer the mortal wounds from that attack.
value.q: When I use the Shambling Wall stratagem, what happens to my opponent’s [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks?

value.a:
Когда атака с [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] даёт критическое ранение, последовательность атаки для этой атаки заканчивается. Такие ранения не попадают в «пул» ранений, которые ваш оппонент разрешает при использовании этой стратагемы, а смертельные раны от этих атак всё равно получает юнит-цель (ваш юнит POXWALKERS не может их «поглотить»).

Пример: если две атаки [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] вашего оппонента дали одно ранение и одно критическое ранение, оппонент разрешит ранение так, как описано в вашей стратагеме, но для критического ранения последовательность атаки закончится, и цель оппонента получит смертельные раны от этой атаки.
value.q: Что происходит с атаками [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] моего оппонента, когда я использую стратагему Shambling Wall?

value.a:
You will resolve the Feel No Pain rolls for your unit each time your opponent follows the steps in your stratagem.

Example: If your opponent has three attacks that wound, each with D 3, they would end the attack sequence for one of those wounds, your unit would make three Feel No Pain rolls, and suffer one mortal wound for each of those rolls that failed. If your DRUKHARI unit is not destroyed, your opponent would end the attack sequence for the next wound, and so on.
value.q: When I use the Double-cross stratagem, what happens if my DRUKHARI unit has Feel No Pain?

value.a:
Вы делаете броски Feel No Pain за свой юнит каждый раз, когда оппонент выполняет шаги вашей стратагемы.

Пример: если у оппонента три атаки нанесли ранения, каждая с D 3, он заканчивает последовательность атаки для одного из этих ранений, ваш юнит делает три броска Feel No Pain и получает одну смертельную рану за каждый проваленный бросок. Если ваш юнит DRUKHARI не уничтожен, оппонент заканчивает последовательность атаки для следующего ранения, и так далее.
value.q: Что происходит, когда я использую стратагему Double-cross, если у моего юнита DRUKHARI есть Feel No Pain?

value.a:
If your opponent ends the attack sequence for a [LETHAL HITS] attack that resulted in a critical hit, that attack has no further effect (there is no 'automatic wound'). If your opponent ends the attack sequence for a [SUSTAINED HITS] attack that resulted in a critical hit, that will not also remove the additional hits generated by that attack - those hits will still be resolved step by step as described by the stratagem.

For example, if your opponent removes a critical hit with [SUSTAINED HITS 1], there will still be a hit from that attack left to resolve: the hit generated by [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. If the GRETCHIN unit has been destroyed, the attack sequence will continue for that hit.
value.q: When I use the Grot Shields stratagem, what happens to my opponent's [LETHAL HITS]/[SUSTAINED HITS] attacks?

value.a:
Если оппонент заканчивает последовательность атаки для атаки [LETHAL HITS], давшей критическое попадание, эта атака больше ничего не делает (нет «автоматического ранения»). Если оппонент заканчивает последовательность атаки для атаки [SUSTAINED HITS], давшей критическое попадание, это не убирает дополнительные попадания этой атаки — они всё равно разрешаются шаг за шагом, как описано в стратагеме.

Например, если оппонент убирает критическое попадание с [SUSTAINED HITS 1], от этой атаки остаётся ещё одно попадание: то, что дал [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. Если юнит GRETCHIN уже уничтожен, последовательность атаки продолжается для этого попадания.
value.q: Что происходит с атаками [LETHAL HITS]/[SUSTAINED HITS] моего оппонента, когда я использую стратагему Grot Shields?

items.q: When a revived CHARACTER model comes back as a new unit, do that unit's 'while leading' abilities still work?
When a model with a 'fight on death' ability is destroyed, do that model's keywords still apply to that model's unit until that model is removed from the battlefield?

items.a:
Models awaiting a Fight On Death ability are still present on the battlefield for all rules purposes. This includes (but is not limited to) the following regarding such models:
▪ They can be measured to by friendly/enemy abilities.
▪ They can be considered visible to friendly/enemy models where relevant.
▪ They can use their datasheet abilities.
▪ While making attacks, the destroyed model is considered to have 1 wound remaining, unless otherwise stated.
▪ They can be targeted by stratagems.
▪ Enemy units can still be engaged with them (which may restrict the opposing player's consolidation/pile-in moves made as part of an overrun fight).
items.q: Fight On Death (05.04.05) requires models awaiting such an ability to stay on the battlefield until their unit has attacked (or until the end of the phase). How do these models function while this is the case?

items.text: When you select a unit to make a fall-back move, if that unit has an ability that allows models in that unit to move through all types of model, you do not need to select the desperate escape mode for models in that unit to move through enemy models.
items.title: Desperate Escape and Moving Through Models

items.q: When I’m moving a model (excluding INFANTRY/BEASTS/SWARM/MOBILE models) horizontally through a dense terrain feature, and the path that model takes only goes over parts of that dense terrain feature that are less than 2" in height, do I have to move that model vertically?
When I select a unit to shoot, if that unit makes no attacks, is it still hidden?
Can I use a stratagem that specifically targets a stated number of units (e.g. 'two') when I have fewer than that number of eligible units to target?
If an attached unit with a CHARACTER model contains a bodyguard unit with an enhancement, and that bodyguard unit is destroyed, does the CHARACTER model still have the benefit of the enhancement?

items.a: Only the unit that includes that CHARACTER model.
items.q: If I attach a CHARACTER model to a unit that is later split, which of the two 'new' units benefits from that CHARACTER model's 'while leading'/'this unit' abilities?

If an ability says that when my unit arrives from strategic reserves, I treat the battle round number as being one higher than it is, can the unit using that ability make an ingress move in my first turn?
If an ability places my unit in strategic reserves and says that my unit must make an ingress move in this/my next Movement phase, can that unit make an ingress move in my first turn?
When a model makes a surge move, does that model have to move the maximum distance permitted by that move?

If I have given an upgrade enhancement to my CHARACTER leader/support unit that is part of an attached unit, if the bearer of the upgrade enhancement is then destroyed (via [PRECISION] attacks or other means), does the unit still benefit from the upgrade enhancement?
If I have an ability that reduces damage, does this work against [DEVASTATING WOUNDS]?

For the purposes of scoring the Consecrate Primary Mission, if I am using the Adeptus Custodes Lions of the Emperor detachment and I target a consecration unit with the Unleash the Lions stratagem, are the new units consecration units?

For the purposes of scoring the Beacon Secondary Mission, if I am using the Adeptus Custodes Lions of the Emperor detachment and I target my beacon unit with the Unleash the Lions stratagem, are the new units beacon units?

For the purposes of scoring the Punishment Primary Mission, if my opponent is using the Adeptus Custodes Lions of the Emperor detachment and they target a condemned unit with the Unleash the Lions stratagem, does that unit leave the battlefield?

On layouts that have a terrain area 6" from a battlefield edge, can a unit come in 6" from the battlefield edge via strategic reserves and start the Plunder action for that terrain area, or contest that objective?

When using the Divine Intervention stratagem, can I use any of the Miracle dice that were generated when that CHARACTER was destroyed as part of the Miracle dice I can discard to set that CHARACTER back up?

Can a Shield-Captain use its Master of Ka'tahs ability to activate both the Dacatarai and Kaptaris ka'tah abilities in the same phase, by activating one, using Master of Ka'tahs to become readied, then activating the other?
When I target a unit with the Unleash the Lions stratagem, is that unit destroyed?
When I target a unit with the Unleash the Lions stratagem, does that unit leave the battlefield?
When I target a unit with the Unleash the Lions stratagem, do persisting rules effects pass to the new units (e.g. Fulgrim's Daemonic Poisons ability)?
When I target a unit with the Unleash the Lions stratagem, do the new units have their 'once per battle' abilities even if the original unit used those abilities?

items.a: The unit singled out no longer exists but is not destroyed, so your unit will not be able to reselect a unit to be singled out.

items.target: Shamblerot Vectorium Detachment, Shambling Wall Stratagem, Effect
items.text:
When an enemy unit is making attacks, at the end of the Wound Rolls step, if those attacks target that DEATH GUARD unit, your opponent does the following:
▪ Select one wound.
▪ End the attack sequence for that wound.
▪ A number of models in your POXWALKERS unit equal to that attack’s D are destroyed.

Your opponent repeats these steps until there are no wounds to resolve, or until your POXWALKERS unit is destroyed (whichever happens first). When your POXWALKERS unit is destroyed, the attack sequence continues for any remaining attacks.

items.target: Lord of Contagion, Unholy Resilience ability
items.text: (Once per battle, per unit) When a friendly model with this ability is destroyed, roll one D6 at the end of the phase. On a 2+, set that model back up on the battlefield, as close as possible to where it was destroyed, unengaged, with 3 wounds remaining. Each model can only be set up in this way once per battle.

items.a:
When an attack with [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] results in a critical wound, the attack sequence ends for that attack. Those wounds will not be in the ‘pool’ of wounds that your opponent resolves when you use this stratagem, and the mortal wounds that result from those attacks will still be suffered by the target unit (your POXWALKERS unit cannot ‘absorb’ them).

Example: If your opponent’s two [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks result in one wound and one critical wound, your opponent would resolve the wound as described in your stratagem, but the attack sequence would end for the critical wound, and your opponent’s target would suffer the mortal wounds from that attack.
items.q: When I use the Shambling Wall stratagem, what happens to my opponent’s [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks?

items.a: No, the remaining damage is lost.
items.q: When I use the Shambling Wall stratagem, what happens if an attack with D greater than 1 destroys the last POXWALKER model? Does the remaining damage ‘spill over’ to the target unit?
If my Chaos Spawn unit is destroyed by melee attacks, is that unit’s Lethal Ichor ability still resolved for those attacks?

Your opponent repeats these steps until there are no wounds to resolve, or until your DRUKHARI unit is destroyed (whichever happens first). When your DRUKHARI unit is destroyed, the attack sequence continues for any remaining attacks.

items.a:
When an attack with [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] results in a critical wound, the attack sequence ends for that attack. Those wounds will not be in the ‘pool’ of wounds that your opponent resolves when you use this stratagem, and the mortal wounds that result from those attacks will still be suffered by the target unit (your DRUKHARI unit cannot ‘absorb’ them).

items.q: When I use the Double-cross stratagem, what happens to my opponent’s [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] attacks?

items.a: No, the remaining damage is lost.
items.q: When I use the Double-cross stratagem, what happens if an attack with D greater than 1 destroys the last DRUKHARI model? Does the remaining damage ‘spill over’ to the target unit?

items.a:
You will resolve the Feel No Pain rolls for your unit each time your opponent follows the steps in your stratagem.

Example: If your opponent has three attacks that wound, each with D 3, they would end the attack sequence for one of those wounds, your unit would make three Feel No Pain rolls, and suffer one mortal wound for each of those rolls that failed. If your DRUKHARI unit is not destroyed, your opponent would end the attack sequence for the next wound, and so on.

items.text:
When an enemy unit is making attacks, at the end of the Hit Rolls step, if those attacks target that ORKS INFANTRY unit, your opponent does the following:
▪ Select one hit.
▪ End the attack sequence for that hit.
▪ Your GRETCHIN unit suffers one mortal wound.

Your opponent repeats these steps until there are no hits to resolve, or until your GRETCHIN unit is destroyed (whichever happens first). When your GRETCHIN unit is destroyed, the attack sequence continues for any remaining hits.

items.a:
If your opponent ends the attack sequence for a [LETHAL HITS] attack that resulted in a critical hit, that attack has no further effect (there is no 'automatic wound'). If your opponent ends the attack sequence for a [SUSTAINED HITS] attack that resulted in a critical hit, that will not also remove the additional hits generated by that attack - those hits will still be resolved step by step as described by the stratagem.

For example, if your opponent removes a critical hit with [SUSTAINED HITS 1], there will still be a hit from that attack left to resolve: the hit generated by [SUSTAINED HITS 1]. If the GRETCHIN unit has been destroyed, the attack sequence will continue for that hit.
